notes_for_reviewer: The acceptance criteria mention dict-based symbol conditions ({"feature": "symbol", ...}), but the actual codebase uses string-based conditions ('symbol is S'). This implementation matches the codebase convention (consistent with rb_governor._symbol_condition() and cpu_engine.parse_symbol_condition()).
Purged CV is disabled via `_cfg.PHASE2_CV_FILTER_ENABLED = False` inside a try/finally block to ensure restoration.
The `_tag_pool_with_symbol` helper uses `'symbol is {symbol}'` string format (not dict format) to match the existing project convention.
No changes to phase2_rule_pool.py — the purged CV override is done at the pipeline level in run_pipeline.py.
Backward compat verified: PER_SYMBOL_PHASE2=False restores original single combined behavior via the else branch.
